answer.answer: NCEI's microplastic database compiles heterogeneous studies with vastly different sampling, extraction, and counting methods, so even same-mesh-net pairs near in space/time often differ by orders of magnitude due to non-harmonized protocols rather than true environmental variation. No single validated median factor across such pairs has been established in the literature.
